t: This is Kensington Court Gardens, a late Victorian mansion block completed in 1889, close to Kensington Palace and its gardens. It was once the home of T. S. Eliot. Several others ended their lives here. Arthur Raikes, a British army officer, served as acting prime minister and first minister to a number of Sultans of Zanzibar, fought on the pro-British side in the Anglo-Zanzibar War, and helped negotiate the boundary between Zanzibari and British territory on the African mainland. The painter Ethel Quixano Henriques and the judge James O'Kinealy also died here.
